Application Data.NAME: Sweet Treats Confections, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Treats Confections, Inc. operates a retail candy store specializing in a wide variety of high-quality confections, including chocolates, gummies, and seasonal treats. The store focuses on maintaining a family-friendly environment, offering both in-store purchases and an online shopping platform for local delivery. Our operations prioritize excellent customer service, with staff trained in product knowledge and safety protocols. We implement robust inventory controls to minimize loss and ensure product freshness. The business is located in a low-crime suburban area, enhancing safety and security for our store and customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2023, a minor water leak was discovered in the store's storage area, caused by a faulty air conditioning unit. The damage was limited to $1,000 for cleanup and repairs. The claim was closed successfully, and all repairs were completed promptly with no impact on business operations.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Safe Model 1234, Key Lock, 1500 lbs capacity
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security system with central station monitoring, motion sensors, and key card access for employees.
